metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill at validation_phase stage addressing no-wait locking and abort-retry patterns in optimistic concurrency control (TicToc). It does not semantically overlap with existing skills: the two existing session_skills target third-party script optimization and thread pool configuration (unrelated domains), and the three peer_candidates address parallel logging coordination, timestamp delta encoding, and abort root cause analysis—all different capabilities. The candidate has direct support evidence (section 4.1) and introduces a novel intervention pattern (lock-free abort + sleep + retry) not present in the registry.
